findings.evidence: Lines 143–146 explicitly say the coefficient synonym is exposed so both sides reduce definitionally.
findings.fix: Transport the equality explicitly through `Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra.algEquivSelf` and its application lemmas instead of using `change ...; rfl`.
findings.issue: `tangentScalarExtensionEquiv_tmul_eq` closes by unfolding `CounitAlgebra` until the goal becomes reflexive, so it depends on the synonym's implementation.

findings.evidence: Lines 164–182 replace the goal definitionally with the full `toConv`/`ofConv` expression; `Lie/Basic.lean` already contains the relevant facts only as private lemmas.
findings.fix: Export an appropriate convolution-normal-form lemma (the existing `bracket_apply_ofConv`/`toConv_coe_bracket` facts in `Lie/Basic.lean` are private) and rewrite with it before applying scalar-distribution lemmas.
findings.issue: `bracket_smul` uses a large `change` to unfold the derivation bracket through `WithConv`, bypassing the public bracket interface and coupling the proof to internal representation.

summary: Two proofs depend on fragile definitional unfolding across the coefficient synonym and convolution wrappers.
